plan_name: New India Senior Citizen Mediclaim Policy

room_rent.note: Room/boarding/nursing up to 1% of SI per day; room+ICU overall capped at 25% of SI

icu.note: ICU/ICCU up to 2% of SI per day; room+ICU overall limit 25% of SI

copayment.note: Mandatory: liability = lesser of SI or 90% of admissible claim (Clause 5.17)

sub_limits.note: Disease-wise surgical caps (e.g. appendicectomy ₹10k, cholecystectomy ₹22k, prostate ₹16k, hernia ₹18k); modern treatments all 10% of SI; surgeon fees capped 25-50% of SI

ped_waiting.note: Diabetes & Hypertension covered from inception on extra premium

specific_disease_waiting.note: Tiered 90 days / 18 mo / 36 mo lists; listed-disease bulk at 18 months

cumulative_bonus.note: +5% SI per claim-free year, max 30%; reduced at same rate on claim

restoration.note: VERIFY - no SI restoration/reinstatement clause found

pre_hosp.note: Capped at max 5% of hospital bill

post_hosp.note: Capped at max 10% of hospital bill

domiciliary.note: VERIFY - domiciliary defined; inclusion/exclusion not confirmed

organ_donor.note: Donor hospitalisation expenses (excl. organ cost) within SI (Clause 3.6)

modern_treatments.note: All listed modern treatments capped at 10% of SI per policy period

global_cover.note: All treatment must be taken in India (Clause 5.14)

notable_exclusions.display: Maternity excluded; treatment must be in India; heavy disease-wise surgical sub-limits; standard IRDAI Excl01-18
